doc: Every item the game or a mod defines: stack sizes, rarity, levels, the gear numbers a tooltip shows (power, speed, damage, armour), costs, perks and sockets.

ids.rule: The stable name starts as the item's debug name in lower case (Material_T1_Wood_Logs is game:material_t1_wood_logs). An item without a debug name is game:item_<its 32-bit item id as 8 hex digits>. When two items would get the same name, the one that held it first keeps it and the other is game:<name>~<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>.

maxStack.doc: The largest stack. In place before the world's save is read: a lower value cuts stacks in that save.

rarity.doc: The rarity a new copy gets when it does not roll one. Copies that exist keep theirs.

rolled.doc: New copies roll their rarity (and perks) instead of taking rarity. Copies that exist keep theirs.

levels.doc: The item's level range. New copies are made inside it; a save load clamps existing copies into it.

min.doc: The lowest level (also the level power and armour are shown at).

socket.doc: New copies get a gem socket.

perks.doc: The perk of each rarity slot, common first. A copy fills rarity + 1 slots. New copies only.

power.doc: The damage the tooltip shows at levels.min. Kiln solves the game's damage factor for it with the balance table's constants.

speed.doc: The speed factor of the weapon's damage (multiplies power).

hasDamage.doc: The item deals damage (power, speed and damage apply).

damage.doc: The kinds of damage a hit deals. The hit kinds (cut to poison) are shares that should add up to 1; wood, stone, metal and explosion are whole numbers.

cut.doc: The share of a hit dealt as cut damage.

pierce.doc: The share of a hit dealt as pierce damage.

blunt.doc: The share of a hit dealt as blunt damage.

fire.doc: The share of a hit dealt as fire damage.

ice.doc: The share of a hit dealt as ice damage.

shroud.doc: The share of a hit dealt as shroud damage.

lightning.doc: The share of a hit dealt as lightning damage.

poison.doc: The share of a hit dealt as poison damage.

healing.doc: The share of a hit that heals instead of hurting; not counted in the hit shares.

wood.doc: The damage a hit deals to wood, a whole number.

stone.doc: The damage a hit deals to stone, a whole number.

metal.doc: The damage a hit deals to metal, a whole number.

explosion.doc: The explosion damage a hit deals, a whole number.

armor.doc: The armour of each kind the tooltip shows at levels.min. Kiln solves the game's share for it with the balance table's constants.

physical.doc: The physical armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

magical.doc: The magical armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

cut.doc: The cut armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

pierce.doc: The pierce armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

blunt.doc: The blunt armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

fire.doc: The fire armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

ice.doc: The ice armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

shroud.doc: The shroud armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

lightning.doc: The lightning armour the tooltip shows at levels.min.

block.doc: How well the item blocks (0 to 1). When the game reads it is not traced yet: unproven until a Kiln update maps it.

staminaCost.doc: The stamina a use costs, at the next payment.

manaCost.doc: The mana a use costs, at the next cast.

fuel.doc: What the item gives as fuel. When the game reads it is not traced yet: unproven until a Kiln update maps it.

comfort.doc: The comfort the item gives when placed. When the game reads it is not traced yet: unproven until a Kiln update maps it.

entry.removeDoc: GameStart only. Retains records and usable saved copies in inventory, equipment and containers; hides random loot and dependent recipes, and disables direct-drop slots without resizing. Whole removal is refused for unproven drop/recipe dependencies, missing group metadata or a group with no surviving spawnable stack. Removal wins later registry chance/weight conflicts.
